options.fileName is used to build a filesystem path
(path.join(tempDir.name, fileName)) and the caller-supplied document buffer is
written there, but fileName is never reduced to a base name. A fileName containing
"../" escapes the temporary directory, so a caller can write arbitrary content to an
arbitrary path the process can write to (e.g. ~/.ssh/authorized_keys, an /etc/cron.d
entry, or a web root).

### Patches
Version 1.8.2 uses `path.basename` on `filename` to make sure the temp directory can not be escaped.

### Workarounds
Make sure you supply the filename yourself and don't have it user supplied or use `path.basename` on `filename` before using it in `libreoffice-convert`.", "ghsa_id": "GHSA-gmxc-r82q-347r", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-08-27T17:23:16Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-gmxc-r82q-347r", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-gmxc-r82q-347r"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-54732"}], "nvd_published_at": null, "published_at": "2026-08-27T17:23:16Z", "references": ["https://github.com/elwerene/libreoffice-convert/security/advisories/GHSA-gmxc-r82q-347r", "https://github.com/elwerene/libreoffice-convert/commit/b78f17df9b9183bd503fc4635fc8b3df6705047b", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-gmxc-r82q-347r"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/elwerene/libreoffice-convert/security-advisories/GHSA-gmxc-r82q-347r", "severity": "medium", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/elwerene/libreoffice-convert", "summary": "libreoffice-convert vulnerable to path traversal / arbitrary file write", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-08-27T17:23:17Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-gmxc-r82q-347r", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "1.8.2", "package": {"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "libreoffice-convert"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "< 1.8.2"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
